verdict.rationale: Letta documents "dreaming": background subagents review recent conversations, consolidate useful lessons and update memory without interrupting active work. Configurable triggers (after a number of steps or on context compaction) make it autonomous rather than user-driven, and even explicit /remember lessons are placed by the agent itself. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how salient facts are selected and extracted from raw conversation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of consolidation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the memory layer decides for itself what is worth remembering — extracting salient facts from raw conversation and consolidating them in the background

citations.quote: Dreaming uses background subagents to review recent conversations, consolidate useful lessons, and update memory without interrupting your active work.
trigger controls when dreaming runs: after a number of steps, on context compaction, or never.
The agent decides where the lesson belongs and commits the update to MemFS.
